name: send_email
description: Send an email to one person with a proposed plan or a status update. Use this to deliver proposals and to report back when no plan could be found.

person.description: The person's name as listed among the group's members

is_proposal.description: Set to true only when this email is an actual plan proposal with a concrete time/activity/venue the recipient can respond to. This adds one-click Accept / Decline / Tentative buttons to the email - no free-text reply needed. Leave false (or omit) for status updates, e.g. reporting that no plan could be found. Ignored (treated as true) when 'options' is set.

options.description: 2-4 candidate venues for the recipient to vote between (e.g. straight from find_nearby_places). When set, the email shows one card per option with its own 'Vote for this' button, plus a single 'I'm out' decline button, instead of the single-option Accept/Decline/Tentative buttons. Pass the EXACT SAME list in the EXACT SAME order for every recipient of this proposal - option IDs are assigned by position, so a mismatched order would tally votes against the wrong option. Omit for a single-option proposal or a non-proposal status update.

distance_km.description: Optional - only include if find_nearby_places actually returned it for this venue.

cuisine.description: Optional - only include if find_nearby_places actually returned it for this venue.
